description: Defines data structures related to layer snapshots in the Android SurfaceFlinger frontend, including state representations for rendering and composition.

classes.name: RoundedCornerState
classes.description: Represents the state of rounded corners for a layer, including crop rectangle and radius.

classes.name: ChildState
classes.description: Indicates whether the child layer has a valid frame rate.

classes.name: LayerSnapshot
classes.description: Stores the state of a layer used by the CompositionEngine and RenderEngine, including visual properties, transform, metadata, and state flags.

methods.name: isOpaqueFormat
methods.description: Checks if a given pixel format is opaque.

methods.name: canReceiveInput
methods.description: Determines if the layer can receive input.

methods.name: drawShadows
methods.description: Checks if the layer should draw shadows.

methods.name: fillsColor
methods.description: Checks if the layer fills with color.

methods.name: getIsVisible
methods.description: Determines if the layer is visible.

methods.name: hasBlur
methods.description: Checks if the layer has a blur effect.

methods.name: hasBufferOrSidebandStream
methods.description: Checks if the layer has a buffer or sideband stream.

methods.name: hasEffect
methods.description: Checks if the layer has any effects.

methods.name: hasSomethingToDraw
methods.description: Determines if the layer has drawable content.

methods.name: isContentOpaque
methods.description: Checks if the content is opaque.

methods.name: isHiddenByPolicy
methods.description: Checks if the layer is hidden by policy.

methods.name: getDebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string describing the layer snapshot.

methods.name: getIsVisibleReason
methods.description: Provides the reason why the layer is visible or not.

methods.name: hasInputInfo
methods.description: Checks if input info is available for the layer.

methods.name: sourceBounds
methods.description: Returns the source bounds of the layer.
